And not a drop of ale for almost a week now.

DAY SIX

Cold again. Snows. Trolls. No ale.

DAY SEVEN

Snow below so white,
Sky above so blue,
Wolves will howl the night,
Not a drop of brew.

DAY EIGHT

The trolls are perhaps not as large a problem as we initially thought. They have some
0d74fd95.title: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal

71c0906c.text:
managed to get the better of the ugly brute, but he's now nursing a nasty cut on his arm. Looks like I'll have to do the chores for a while.

DAY THREE

Cold. Snowed a bit around noon.

DAY FOUR

The lad was back and in good spirits today, so we took our first look at the trolls. Frostmane, I'd say, judging by the markings on their skin and the various trinkets they wore on their bodies.
71c0906c.title: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal

bdb623e3.text:
DAY FIVE

Had the lad watch over the camp and I snuck over to the cave and took a look around. The trolls' numbers are somewhat troublesome. The Mountaineers might have to be summoned in force if the cave is to be cleared of the troll infestation.

I realize I have not mentioned the troggs of late. They appear in the area in greater numbers, but they are so primitive that they do not pose much of a threat. Time may say if this is true or not.
bdb623e3.title: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal

cdac24ff.text:
A Report on the State of the Frostmane Trolls in the General Area of Coldridge Valley

Prepared by Grelin Whitebeard, Senate Special Envoy

From the time that I have spent observing the movement of the Frostmane trolls in the Coldridge Valley area, I have determined that they pose no large threat to dwarven settlements in the area. Moreover, they are a threat that can be eliminated with little additional support from the army. Through the assistance of Mountaineers already stationed in
cdac24ff.title: Grelin's Report

cfb4dfed.text:
DAY ONE

The apprentice and I have arrived in Coldridge Valley today. The trip through the cave was mostly uneventful. We made camp a good distance away from the cave we're told the trolls have gathered in.

DAY TWO

Bloody wolf howling almost kept me up all night.

I will have new wolfhide clothing in a few days.

The lad got tangled up with a trogg today, put up a fight, and
cfb4dfed.title: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1247|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1702|263b99e7.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
1702|263b99e7.text: Just a minor adjustment here... ah there we go!

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

267336|0371bf6f.name: Brighid Stormflayer
267336|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

2878|0e051c59.name: Peria Lamenur
2878|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

727|88f20f16.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|88f20f16.text: If ye ask me, I think Grif spends a little too much time with the animals.  Still, nobody else knows the $c's path quite like he does.  Look for him outside the smithy in Kharanos.

7954|fd743840.name: Binjy Featherwhistle
7954|fd743840.text: You need to be exalted with the gnomes of the Gnomeregan Exiles before I will teach you how to pilot a Mechanostrider, $c.

7955|53cc47ec.name: Milli Featherwhistle
7955|53cc47ec.text: Erm... I really don't know you that well, sorry.  I mean, as an authorized Mechanostrider dealer, I really only can sell my mounts to those people who are considered exalted amongst the gnomes.  If you ever are recognized as exalted to Gnomeregan, I'd be happy to show you what I have to offer.

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

895|a665cdb8.name: Thorgas Grimson
895|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

96055-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96055-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
